name: Jingai Makyou
source:
Kumon Katsuki feels as if he was born without a heart. Ever since he was young, he's had a hard time reading the mood or empathizing with others; having to resort to using his brain instead of his emotions in order to get by in social situations. Because of this inability to read the atmosphere, the only people he has been able to maintain meaningful relationships with are his Landlady, Hanawa Momiji, and his two friends, Mineyuki Ryou and Makimoto Misae.

One day, Katsuki's younger sister, Megumi, decides to visit him from abroad. What should be a joyous reunion, however, coincides with a series of bizarre incidents occurring around Katsuki. 

Among them are a series of strange dreams where he meets a young woman with an umbrella; only to have an encounter with her in the waking world. On top of that, a series of violent murders has begun sweeping the town Katsuki lives in—the victims looking as though they've been mauled by some large animal. However, the strangest of them all is an encounter with an enigmatic woman who claims that Katsuki is something called "The Gate".

Will Katsuki survive the series of event he's now found himself the center of, or will he meet his end?
translation:
九门克绮觉得自己生来就没有心。从小到大，他一直难以察言观色，也无法与他人共情；在社交场合中，他只能依靠理性思考，而非情感来应对。由于不能领会周围的气氛，他唯一能够维持有意义关系的人，只有房东花轮红叶，以及两位朋友峰雪亮与牧本美佐枝。

一天，克绮的妹妹惠决定从国外前来探望他。这场本应令人欣喜的重逢，却恰逢克绮身边接连发生一系列怪事。

其中包括反复出现的怪梦：梦里，他遇见了一名撑伞的年轻女子，后来竟又在现实中与她相逢。与此同时，克绮居住的城镇发生了一连串残暴的杀人案件，受害者看起来仿佛遭到某种大型动物撕咬。然而，最诡异的还是一名神秘女子的出现——她声称克绮是所谓的“门”。

克绮能否从这场以自己为中心的连串事件中活下来，还是会就此迎来末日？
